description: List every product in your workspace (unpaginated): each product's id, name, country, competitor count, and its linked store versions (Sonar app id, store, store_id, name). Product ids are what sonar_track_app, sonar_track_competitor, sonar_remove_competitor, sonar_delete_product, and the screenshot-set tools take; for per-app snapshots and competitor apps use sonar_list_apps. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts).
name: sonar_list_products
title: List Products
